FloPlast 114mm square external stop end provides a neat, robust finish for square guttering systems. These essential drainage components prevent water overflow at the end of a gutter run, ensuring efficient rainwater management for buildings. This solution is suitable for new build projects and refurbishment applications, offering a clean, rectilinear profile that complements modern and traditional façades. Manufactured from durable uPVC, it features pre-lubricated gutter seals for easy, watertight installation and includes a pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip system for added security. The 114mm white square stop end is designed for external use, ensuring a long-lasting, low-maintenance finish compatible with most major manufacturers' square gutter systems.
